info.title: API.SH: Cars.com
info.description: The Cars.com API from API.SH: public Cars.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Cars.com dealer: name, address, coordinates, rating and review count, phone numbers (sales new, used, service), website, sales and service hours, service center, description, tagline, years on Cars.com, photos, awards, employees, rating breakdown, a link to its inventory search and its most recent reviews, plus `raw`. Use /carscom/v1/search with dealer_id for the dealer's cars.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carscom-dealer

parameters.description: A cars.com/dealers/<id>/<name>/ link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The dealer id instead (the number in the link).

get.description:

get.summary: Cars.com consumer reviews of a car model
get.description:
Owner reviews of a car model (and model year) on Cars.com: overall rating, review count, share of drivers who recommend it, the rating breakdown (comfort, interior, performance, value, exterior, reliability), and each review's rating, title, date, author and location, whether they own or test drove it, text, sub-ratings, new or used purchase, use and recommendation, and helpful votes. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carscom-reviews

get.summary: Cars.com new and used car search
get.description:
Search Cars.com's new, used and certified listings with every filter the site offers: make, model, trim, ZIP code and distance, price, year, mileage, body style, size, cab type, colors, fuel, transmission, drivetrain, cylinders, doors, electric range, deal rating, seller type, certified program, lifestyle, convenience, entertainment, exterior, safety and seating features, keyword and dealer. Each listing has its id, link, title, year, make, model, trim, stock type, price, MSRP, price drop, estimated monthly payment, mileage, VIN, body style, color, fuel, drivetrain, deal and other badges, dealer name, rating and location, distance, sponsored flag and photos, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carscom-search

get.description:
One Cars.com listing: title, year, make, model, trim, stock type, certified program, price, estimated monthly payment, mileage, VIN, stock number, body style, exterior and interior color, fuel, drivetrain, badges, deal rating with the fair-price range, price history, vehicle history flags (accidents, owners, title, open recalls), basics (engine, MPG, transmission), every feature by group, the seller's notes, the dealer (name, id, rating, review count, address, website, hours, about), the model's consumer rating and all photos, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carscom-vehicle

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The listing id (the part after /vehicledetail/ in a cars.com link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A cars.com/vehicledetail/<id>/ link instead.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first listing of a search with the /carscom/v1/search params given alongside (make, model, zip...). Then id is not needed.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: With latest: the search's make.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: With latest: the search's ZIP code.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
